name: La Iglesuela del Tiétar (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided green over red with a white triangle at the hoist bearing the crowned arms of La Iglesuela del Tiétar (a church tower on green and a holm oak on white).
history: The descriptions of the heraldic arms and the flag were approved on 11 June 1993 and published in the Diario Oficial de Castilla-La Mancha of 18 June 1993; the arms are party per pale, vert a church tower or, and argent a holm oak vert eradicated, with a closed royal crown. The flag is rectangular, of proportions 3:5, divided horizontally into two halves, green above and red below, with a white triangle whose base coincides with the hoist and whose apex is at the centre of the cloth, bearing the crowned municipal arms.
